def.label: Mk1 visual sight
def.note: max_range_cells 60 and classify_after_ms 3,000 are 16b section 9's own constants, moved to content as that table says. max_attenuation 40 is cut C's, and it is picked off the atlas's own opacity table rather than out of the air: light woods attenuate 25 and heavy woods 60, so 40 is exactly the line that lets a tank see through one belt of light woods and not through a canopy. sees_wrecks is false, which is what makes doc 16 section 3.3's 'a wreck is an obstacle and a contact, never a target' start as an obstacle only.
